note: Clean-room, Sentinel-authored from the CWE-79 definition. NOT derived from VulnHunterX templates.
questions: Is the flagged value derived from request/user input (params, body, headers, path, or stored user data)?
Is that value written into an HTML/JS response context (template render, Response body, mark_safe/|safe, innerHTML) rather than auto-escaped output?
Is there NO intervening HTML/attribute escaping, sanitizer, or safe-templating between the input and the output sink?
keep_if: untrusted input reaches an HTML/JS sink without escaping or sanitization
